blocks.text: DAVAO CITY, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday joked about filing libel charges against GMA News for allegedly failing to verify some information presented in its story about the claims of now-dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. that he delivered money stuffed in suitcases to her upon instructions of then House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco. “Pwede ko ba i-libel ang GMA News nito? Hindi man lang sila nag-check ba,” Duterte said in jest, eliciting some laughter among some journalists who attended a press conference she called to refute the allegations contained in a Sept. 14 affidavit of Gracioso. “I-libel ko […]...
